chapters.title: Your keyboard is the display.
chapters.detail: Super + Esc opens Arcade. Press again to skip a title or switch games.

chapters.title: Every game gets an entrance.
chapters.detail: Actual five-row LED lettering, on the calibrated keyboard layout.

chapters.title: The menu is already playing.
chapters.detail: A roaming rainbow snake previews the mode. Arrow keys start a fresh round.

chapters.title: Scatter. Spring back. Start.
chapters.detail: The preview bursts outward, then every particle gathers into your new snake.

chapters.title: Eat. Grow. Keep moving.
chapters.detail: Orange head to amber tail. The opening shield breathes for three seconds.

chapters.title: Rainbow frenzy. A wave becomes the timer.
chapters.detail: The fifth apple sends a shockwave to the edges. Dodge bombs until the side LEDs run out.

chapters.title: Next stage, one shutter at a time.
chapters.detail: The snake recolors first. Opposed column shutters count you back into play.

chapters.title: Even losing gets choreography.
chapters.detail: Red travels from head to tail, then the body scatters into embers and goes dark.

chapters.title: A bomb in your path.
chapters.detail: Tapping an empty cell during a frenzy places a flashing red / white hazard.

chapters.title: Rainbow deaths go out differently.
chapters.detail: White ignition, expanding spectrum rings, curved sparks, then blackout.

chapters.title: A different kind of pressure.
chapters.detail: Timer mode: purple snake, fixed pace, and an apple with a deadline.

chapters.title: Edges become portals.
chapters.detail: Cross an edge, reappear one lane over. Eat before white turns yellow, orange, red.

chapters.title: Miss the deadline. Feel the consequence.
chapters.detail: The apple fades away; a procedural death sequence follows the body.

chapters.title: Every game gets an entrance.
chapters.detail: Actual five-row LED lettering, on the calibrated keyboard layout.

chapters.title: Fifty-eight keys. One minefield.
chapters.detail: A live survey preview. The optional widget adds exact clue numbers, shown here.

chapters.title: Tap, release, reveal.
chapters.detail: A safe first opening expands outward as a wave of clues.

chapters.title: Hold to flag.
chapters.detail: A 450 ms hold warms the key to orange. Release keeps the flag in place.

chapters.title: Clues ripple through the board.
chapters.detail: Real seeded layout. Scripted safe reveals; every number comes from neighboring mines.

chapters.title: One wrong tap. Chain detonation.
chapters.detail: The impact spreads across the physical key layout, then the board falls dark.

chapters.title: Every game gets an entrance.
chapters.detail: Actual five-row LED lettering, on the calibrated keyboard layout.

chapters.title: Two paddles. One very small arena.
chapters.detail: Solo AI or two players. The preview plays while the controls orbit in rainbow.

chapters.title: Charge the paddles. Assemble the serve.
chapters.detail: P1: right Shift / right arrow. P2: left Shift / left Ctrl.

chapters.title: A rally across the keys.
chapters.detail: Continuous paddle control, ball trails, wall impacts, and collision ripples.

chapters.title: Every point lights up the score.
chapters.detail: Bottom-right Alt / Fn / Ctrl tally P1. Bottom-left Fn / Super / Alt tally P2.

chapters.title: First to three. Victory wave.
chapters.detail: The winning side washes across the arena. Score LEDs stay lit through the celebration.
